Cut the kernels off the corn cobs. Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, paprika and a good pinch of salt into a thick batter, then stir in the corn and spring onions. Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and drop in heaped tablespoons of batter, pressing them flat. Fry 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through, in batches, and drain on paper towel. Serve hot with sour cream and snipped chives.
M: Buttery mash sculpted tall, with slow cooked onion gravy poured over
Floury potatoes riced and beaten with hot milk and lots of butter, piled into a tall mountain, onion gravy poured over the top.
the family dinner that goes off the rails

Dry-brined chicken with thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden and crisp, with buttered peas and carrots and a simple pan gravy. Salt a 1.8kg chicken all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Mash 50g soft butter with thyme leaves and push it under the breast skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Boil 4 sliced carrots for 6 minutes and 300g frozen peas for 3, then toss in butter.
W: Tall chocolate cake with ridged chocolate buttercream
Chocolate cake stacked tall, covered in chocolate buttercream with vertical ridges dragged in with a fork.
Saucer shaped meringues with a dot of lemon curd underneath
Swiss meringue piped into saucer shapes, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, a dot of lemon curd underneath.
K: Fresh strawberry and lemon juice lemonade over ice, no alcohol

Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with ripe strawberries, topped up with chilled water in a big jug over ice with mint. Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with 120ml sugar syrup until smooth and strain into a large jug. Stir in 150ml fresh lemon juice and 700ml cold water. Add plenty of ice, sliced strawberries and lemon wheels. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a mint sprig.

Heat the oven to 170C and prepare three small tins. Beat half the butter with the sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs.
Fold in the flour, some of the cocoa and the milk, divide between the tins and bake.
Cool completely.
Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and remaining cocoa for buttercream.
Stack the layers tall, cover in buttercream and drag ridges with a fork.
Hull the strawberries, keeping a few to slice. Blitz most of them with the sugar syrup and strain into a jug.

s.note: Seeded crackers topped five ways: cream cheese, pâté, cheddar, salmon, fig
s.how: Lay out 20 seeded crackers in rows of five. Top each row with a different note: 80g cream cheese, 80g chicken liver pâté, 80g sliced cheddar, 100g smoked salmon with dill, and 4 halved fresh or dried figs. Serve straight away so the crackers stay crisp.

s.note: Indiana sweetcorn fritters with sour cream and chives, from Roy's home town

Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and drop in heaped tablespoons of batter, pressing them flat. Fry 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through, in batches, and drain on paper towel. Serve hot with sour cream and snipped chives.

m.note: Buttery mash sculpted tall, with slow cooked onion gravy poured over
m.how: Boil 1.5kg floury potatoes, rice them and beat with 200ml hot milk and 100g butter. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter, stir in a tablespoon of flour and add 400ml beef stock. Pile the mash into a tall mountain and pour gravy over.

w.note: Tall chocolate cake with ridged chocolate buttercream
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in three small tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Stack tall with buttercream of 200g butter, 350g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, then drag ridges with a fork.

w.note: Saucer shaped meringues with a dot of lemon curd underneath
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe into flat saucer shapes with a small dome in the middle. Bake at 100C for 90 minutes and cool. Spread a dot of lemon curd underneath.
